description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing and querying LoanCapitalizedIncomeBalance entities within the Fineract loan portfolio module. It includes various query methods to retrieve balances, calculate totals, and fetch related transaction data.

classes.name: LoanCapitalizedIncomeBalanceRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing LoanCapitalizedIncomeBalance entities, providing custom query methods for balance retrieval and calculations.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Retrieves all non-closed, non-deleted LoanCapitalizedIncomeBalance records for a specific loan.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdAndDeletedFalseAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Retrieves all non-closed, non-deleted LoanCapitalizedIncomeBalance records for a specific loan.

methods.name: findByLoanIdAndLoanTransactionIdAndDeletedFalseAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Finds a specific LoanCapitalizedIncomeBalance by loan ID and transaction ID, excluding deleted and closed records.

methods.name: findRepaymentPeriodDataByLoanId
methods.description: Fetches repayment period data for a specific loan, including transaction details and amounts.

methods.name: calculateCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Calculates the total capitalized income for a specific loan by summing amounts.

methods.name: calculateCapitalizedIncomeAdjustment
methods.description: Calculates the total adjustment amounts for a loan's capitalized income.

methods.name: findBalanceForAdjustment
methods.description: Finds the balance for adjustment purposes based on a specific transaction ID.

methods.name: findBaseTransactionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed base transaction information related to a loan transaction and loan ID.
